notes: Worked examples in every Lab Snapshot module: one tap deals fresh numbers and walks each answer step by step (given, rule, result). Feedback now names the classic traps — strike − 90 tick, dip direction vs opposite strike, flipped E/W bearings, swapped gradient and titration values — and geology rounds show a plain 'how this is checked' audit line.
Weak photo reads now get retake tips and a one-tap retake on the confirm step instead of a dead end, and the in-round protractor reads out the quadrant bearing live as you drag.
